title: Punjab Kings Appoint Paras Mhambrey as Fast Bowling Coach for IPL 2027
excerpt: The former India bowling coach replaces James Hopes, and former Chennai Super Kings staff member Rajiv Kumar takes over as fielding coach from Brad Haddin, as Ricky Ponting reshapes his support staff.
body:
• Punjab Kings have appointed former India bowling coach Paras Mhambrey as fast bowling coach and Rajiv Kumar as fielding coach ahead of IPL 2027, the franchise announced on November 25, 2026.
  • Mhambrey replaces James Hopes and Kumar takes over from Brad Haddin; both predecessors were part of Punjab's coaching staff last season and left last month.
  • Mhambrey was India's bowling coach from 2021 to 2024 under Rahul Dravid, a tenure that included the 2023 ODI World Cup final run and the 2024 T20 World Cup title.
  • He will work under head coach Ricky Ponting, with whom he previously worked at Mumbai Indians.

Punjab Kings have overhauled two key roles in their support staff ahead of IPL 2027, appointing Paras Mhambrey as fast bowling coach and Rajiv Kumar as fielding coach, the franchise announced on November 25, 2026. Mhambrey replaces James Hopes, while Kumar takes over from Brad Haddin. Both Hopes and Haddin were part of Punjab Kings' coaching staff during the previous season and parted ways with the franchise last month, according to ESPNcricinfo.

Mhambrey's record

Mhambrey represented India in Test and ODI cricket and had a successful domestic career with Mumbai, winning multiple Ranji Trophy titles. His coaching experience spans domestic teams, India A and IPL franchise Mumbai Indians. He served as bowling coach of the Indian men's team from 2021 to 2024, helping the side win the ICC Men's T20 World Cup in 2024, the franchise said.

ESPNcricinfo noted that Mhambrey served under head coach Rahul Dravid during that India tenure, which also included India's run to the 2023 ODI World Cup final at home. At franchise level he has had two spells with Mumbai Indians, most recently returning there after his stint with the Indian team; he left Mumbai last month following a restructuring of their coaching setup. At Punjab, he will work alongside head coach Ricky Ponting, having previously worked with him at Mumbai Indians.

Kumar's role

Rajiv Kumar, formerly on the staff of Chennai Super Kings, brings experience in fielding and player development. Punjab Kings said his expertise will be valuable in working with the team's fielding unit and supporting player development through the season.

What it means for Punjab

Punjab Kings have never won the IPL title, despite coming close in 2014, when they lost the final to Kolkata Knight Riders, and in 2025, when they lost the title clash to Royal Challengers Bengaluru, ESPNcricinfo reported. Ponting took charge as head coach prior to IPL 2025 and the team found success straight away. In IPL 2026, PBKS won six straight matches, with one washout, before losing their way — winning just one more and losing six to miss the playoffs. The new appointments give Ponting a reshaped bowling and fielding group as the franchise prepares for IPL 2027.
